mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen by >0.5pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline over the prior 2 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a simultaneous rise in unemployment and decline in job growth (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% and PAYEMS declines over the prior 1 month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening real economic activity, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals housing sector contraction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in job growth (PAYEMS) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines over the prior 2 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that suppresses corporate investment and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS rises over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
